landmarks.name: bridge mural wall
landmarks.description: Large wall panel with a blue sky and suspension bridge graphic.

landmarks.name: tan sectional sofa
landmarks.description: Large L-shaped tan leather sofa.

landmarks.name: curved bar counter
landmarks.description: Long dark counter with a curved overhang above and metal stools.

landmarks.name: grey exit door
landmarks.description: Grey door with a window and green EXIT sign above.

landmarks.name: stacked wall ovens
landmarks.description: Three stainless steel ovens stacked vertically in brown cabinetry.

landmarks.name: blue-lit grey wall
landmarks.description: Plain grey wall section lit by spotlights, between the grey exit door and bridge mural wall.

landmarks.name: central grey pillar
landmarks.description: Thick square grey column near the end of the curved bar counter.

landmarks.name: wall-mounted TV
landmarks.description: Large flat-screen TV on a light yellow-green wall above a black media console.

landmarks.name: square dining tables
landmarks.description: Small square tables with tan chairs near the windows.

landmarks.name: stainless steel refrigerator
landmarks.description: Large double-door stainless steel refrigerator with ice dispenser.

landmarks.name: frosted glass upper cabinets
landmarks.description: White-framed upper cabinets with frosted glass doors.

landmarks.name: orange accent wall
landmarks.description: Bright orange wall section on the lower level with a framed yellow-and-white painting.

landmarks.name: fireplace
landmarks.description: Dark fireplace surround flanked by two large potted plants against the glass exterior wall.

landmarks.name: glass exterior wall
landmarks.description: Floor-to-ceiling grid of dark-framed windows with a glass door.

landmarks.name: blue armchairs
landmarks.description: Pair of dark blue armchairs with curved wooden armrests facing the wall-mounted TV.

landmarks.name: metal staircase
landmarks.description: Staircase with dark perforated metal steps, metal handrails, and a mid-level landing against the glass and concrete walls.

landmarks.name: corkboard with horse photos
landmarks.description: Large brown corkboard panel on the grey concrete stairwell wall with pictures of horses.

landmarks.name: orange wall with gymnast poster
landmarks.description: Orange wall section at the top of the stairs with a large poster of a male gymnast on rings.

landmarks.name: dumbbell racks
landmarks.description: Two vertical grey racks holding black dumbbells on the brown rubber floor.

landmarks.name: yellow-green wall
landmarks.description: Long light yellow-green wall on the upper level with a whiteboard and corkboard.

landmarks.name: blue recycling bin
landmarks.description: Blue plastic recycling bin next to a beige trash can against the yellow-green wall.

landmarks.name: treadmills
landmarks.description: Row of grey treadmills and elliptical machines facing the mezzanine railing.

landmarks.name: mezzanine railing
landmarks.description: Metal and cable railing at the edge of the upper floor overlooking the lower level.

landmarks.name: wall clock on pillar
landmarks.description: Round white wall clock mounted high on a beige pillar near the treadmills.

landmarks.name: cable weight machine
landmarks.description: Tall silver metal frame cable crossover machine near the top of the metal staircase.

landmarks.name: green barrel chair
landmarks.description: Round barrel-back chair with a light green outer shell and dark seat cushion near the bridge mural wall.

connections.how: With the bridge mural wall on your right and the tan sectional sofa on your left, walk straight ahead past the curved bar counter toward the grey exit door and blue-lit grey wall.
Turn around with the blue-lit grey wall behind you and walk straight between the curved bar counter on your right and the bridge mural wall on your left toward the central grey pillar.
Loop around the central grey pillar keeping it on your left and the curved bar counter on your right, passing the square dining tables on your left to reach the stainless steel refrigerator.

With the stainless steel refrigerator on your left, walk along the curved bar counter on your right (or through the narrow passage behind the curved bar counter past the stacked wall ovens on your left) straight toward the grey exit door and blue-lit grey wall.
Turn left into the narrow passage behind the curved bar counter, keeping the counter on your left and passing the stacked wall ovens on your right, to reach the stainless steel refrigerator.
With the blue-lit grey wall on your left and the curved bar counter on your right, walk straight past the bridge mural wall on your left and tan sectional sofa on your right to the wall-mounted TV.
Continue straight with the wall-mounted TV and orange accent wall on your left, and the blue armchairs and fireplace on your right, to reach the glass exterior wall.
At the glass exterior wall past the orange accent wall on your left, turn left to reach the bottom of the metal staircase.
Climb the metal staircase, passing the corkboard with horse photos on your right and turning left at the mid-level landing, to reach the orange wall with gymnast poster at the top.

Turn left at the top of the metal staircase with the orange wall with gymnast poster on your right, and walk straight along the yellow-green wall and blue recycling bin on your right, passing the dumbbell racks and treadmills on your left, to the mezzanine railing.

Turn around at the mezzanine railing and walk back with the yellow-green wall on your left and treadmills on your right, weaving right past the wall clock on pillar and left between the dumbbell racks and cable weight machine toward the orange wall with gymnast poster and metal staircase.
Walk down the metal staircase with the corkboard with horse photos on your left, turning right at the mid-level landing to reach the glass exterior wall at the bottom.
With the glass exterior wall on your left, walk past the orange accent wall on your right and turn right around it to reach the space between the blue armchairs and wall-mounted TV.
With the wall-mounted TV on your right and blue armchairs on your left, walk forward past the green barrel chair to the bridge mural wall.
From the narrow passage beside the bridge mural wall, walk out with the bridge mural wall on your right and turn left past the wall-mounted TV on your left.
From the bottom of the metal staircase, turn right and walk along the glass exterior wall and fireplace on your left to reach the tan sectional sofa on your right.
Walk around the end of the tan sectional sofa keeping it on your right to reach the central grey pillar on your left.
Turn around with the central grey pillar behind you and walk between the tan sectional sofa on your left and the square dining tables on your right toward the fireplace and glass exterior wall ahead.

walk_summary: Start between the bridge mural wall on the right and tan sectional sofa on the left, walking past the curved bar counter on the left to the grey exit door and blue-lit grey wall.
Turn around and walk back between the curved bar counter and tan sectional sofa to the central grey pillar.
Loop left around the central grey pillar, passing the square dining tables on the left to reach the stainless steel refrigerator and frosted glass upper cabinets.
Turn around and walk along the outer side of the curved bar counter, passing the central grey pillar on the right, back to the blue-lit grey wall and grey exit door.
Turn left into the narrow passage behind the curved bar counter and walk past the stainless steel refrigerator on the right toward the square dining tables.
Turn around in the passage and walk back past the stacked wall ovens on the left to the blue-lit grey wall and grey exit door.

Turn right and walk straight past the bridge mural wall on the left, tan sectional sofa on the right, wall-mounted TV and orange accent wall on the left, and blue armchairs and fireplace on the right to the glass exterior wall.
Turn left at the corner past the orange accent wall and climb the metal staircase, passing the corkboard with horse photos on the right, to the orange wall with gymnast poster at the top.
Turn left at the top of the metal staircase and walk past the dumbbell racks and treadmills on the left, and the yellow-green wall and blue recycling bin on the right, to the mezzanine railing.

Turn around at the mezzanine railing and walk back along the yellow-green wall, weaving around the treadmills, wall clock on pillar, dumbbell racks, and cable weight machine toward the top of the metal staircase.
Walk past the metal staircase opening to the upper window corner above the glass exterior wall, then turn around past the cable weight machine.
Turn right and walk down the metal staircase, passing the corkboard with horse photos on the left, to the glass exterior wall at the bottom.

Walk past the glass exterior wall on the left and turn right around the orange accent wall, then walk between the blue armchairs on the left and wall-mounted TV on the right toward the green barrel chair and bridge mural wall.
Turn right into the narrow passage between the bridge mural wall and the back of the wall-mounted TV wall, then turn around and walk back out.
Walk forward past the wall-mounted TV and orange accent wall on the left and the fireplace on the right to the glass exterior wall.
Turn left and climb the metal staircase past the corkboard with horse photos and orange wall with gymnast poster to the upper landing by the dumbbell racks and cable weight machine.
Turn around at the top of the metal staircase and walk back down to the glass exterior wall.
Turn right at the bottom of the metal staircase and walk along the glass exterior wall and fireplace on the left to the tan sectional sofa.

Step around the end of the tan sectional sofa toward the square dining tables and central grey pillar, then turn around and walk between the tan sectional sofa and square dining tables back to the glass exterior wall.

source.camera: held at chest height by a person walking
